roles.summary: At withlayer.ai, I work on conversational AI and full-stack engineering: real-time voice behavior, LLM and agent integrations, backend APIs, and React/Next.js interfaces. My work also includes investigating latency, writing regression tests, and checking data-access boundaries.

sections.title: Voice and real-time systems
sections.body: I work on the technical details that make spoken interaction feel responsive and predictable.
bullets: Develop and debug speech-to-text, language-model response, and text-to-speech integrations using Python and TypeScript, with WebRTC and LiveKit among the tools I work with.
Work on turn detection, interruptions, streaming responses, and connection lifecycle handling, including how the system behaves when a conversation pauses or a connection changes.
Work with speech technologies such as Deepgram and Rime, investigating transcription quality and spoken-output behavior.

sections.title: LLM and agent workflows
sections.body: I contribute to the engineering around model calls: preparing context, handling outputs, and making asynchronous work dependable.
bullets: Implement and refine LLM integrations, prompt construction, context handling, and structured model outputs.
Work on grounding and evaluation so generated responses can be checked against the information available to the system.
Contribute to asynchronous workflows and background processing, including failure handling and consistency between related operations.

sections.title: Full-stack and data work
bullets: Implement application changes across React and Next.js interfaces, TypeScript APIs, and PostgreSQL-backed data flows.
Work through UI states and backend behavior together, including loading, unavailable data, and error cases.
Check authentication, permissions, and tenant-scoped data access as part of implementation and regression testing.

sections.title: Performance and reliability
bullets: Profile response latency and time to first token to understand where time is spent in streaming and asynchronous processing.
Add diagnostics and investigate timing, cancellation, and state-management issues instead of judging responsiveness only by how a demo feels.
Review edge cases involving partial results, interrupted work, and unexpected inputs; validate fixes with targeted checks.

sections.title: Testing and delivery
sections.body: My contribution includes verification and review as well as implementation.
bullets: Write and maintain regression tests, integration checks, and browser-level checks with tools including Vitest and Playwright.
Use automated evaluations to examine AI behavior, and add coverage for failures and data-access boundaries.
Work through code-review feedback and document what has been verified, what remains uncertain, and where a change is ready for release.

roles.summary: Working with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, and MongoDB across applied AI and backend engineering. Focus areas include embeddings, vector retrieval, multimodal AI, data processing, and API integration. Engineering practice spans automated tests, Docker, AWS, and CI/CD.
